brief:
Gaza's Economy Ministry destroyed 4.5 tons of spoiled food in the central zone of the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The operation targeted contaminated foodstuffs deemed unfit for consumption and posing potential health risks to residents across the strip.

The ministry conducted the disposal operation as part of food safety oversight in the central region. No further details were provided regarding the source of the spoilage, storage conditions that led to the contamination, or the specific disposal methods employed during the operation.
